$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for compose-draft-document (spaarkeai-compose-r2 DEF-08). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset (validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests + jps-validate). The drafting REQUEST is the load-bearing LLM input; the session's documents + prior ledger outputs are supplied by the retrieval/context layer (not maker-provided input fields). Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema — use the object-level required array). Custom keyword ledger_resolution is maker metadata (OpenAI-tolerated unknown keyword). No actionId here — it is assigned in Dataverse at deploy time. actionCode carries NO version suffix (owner hygiene).

request.description: The user's drafting request in their own words (e.g. 'write a client letter summarizing the NDA findings', 'draft a memo responding to the termination notice'). The agent loop supplies this from the user's message; the session's documents and prior ledger outputs are grounded in by the retrieval/context layer.
request.ledger_resolution: The user's drafting utterance. Session documents + prior compose/informational ledger outputs are supplied by the context layer at dispatch time (not a maker-provided field).
